_about: Real TMD NWP API (WRF model) responses saved unmodified on 2026-09-30T10:38Z. The OAuth token is sent in the Authorization header and appears nowhere here. Times are +07:00 as published. Units (TMD docs): tc/tc_max/tc_min °C, rh %, rain mm (hourly: per hour; daily: 24-h total), ws10m m/s (daily: maximum), wd10m degrees, cond 1-12 (see lib/adapters/tmdNwp.ts). Limits (TMD docs): 60 requests/min and 100,000 datapoints/hour per user; datapoints = locations x duration x fields.
